Dundee, since 1998

Nobody sleeps outside in this city tonight

Harbour Light Trust keeps forty beds warm every night of the year, and a daytime centre where anyone can get a hot meal, a shower and a caseworker who knows their name.

What a night here looks like

  • Doors open at seven, no referral and no questions
  • A hot meal, a bed and a locker for anything you carry
  • A caseworker in the morning if you want one

Harbour Light Trust, 14 Dock Street, Dundee DD1 3DR. Scottish charity SC012345.
